# Towards Victory — Leaderboard Effects
# Manually maintained — NOT generated by gen_victory.py
#
# tv_update_best_path_effect : country scope — computes the leading victory path
#   variables written: tv_best_progress_pct, tv_best_path (0-5), tv_best_milestone, tv_best_score
#
# tv_update_leaderboard_effect : situation scope — rebuilds the top-5 global ranking
#   variables written: tv_rank_1_country through tv_rank_5_country (situation scope)

# ── Per-country best-path computation ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Reads the 6 progress_pct vars (0-100) already computed by tv_update_all_progress_pct_effect.
# Unset variables default to 0 in EU5, so this is safe at game start.
tv_update_best_path_effect = {
	# Initialise: conquest = path 0
	set_variable = { name = tv_best_progress_pct  value = var:tv_conquest_progress_pct }
	set_variable = { name = tv_best_path          value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_best_milestone      value = var:tv_conquest_milestone }
	set_variable = { name = tv_best_score          value = var:tv_conquest_score }

	# Prosperity = path 1  (>= preserves lower index on equal progress)
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_prosperity_progress_pct
			var:tv_prosperity_progress_pct >= var:tv_best_progress_pct
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_progress_pct  value = var:tv_prosperity_progress_pct }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_path          value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_milestone      value = var:tv_prosperity_milestone }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_score          value = var:tv_prosperity_score }
	}

	# Trade = path 2
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_trade_progress_pct
			var:tv_trade_progress_pct >= var:tv_best_progress_pct
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_progress_pct  value = var:tv_trade_progress_pct }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_path          value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_milestone      value = var:tv_trade_milestone }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_score          value = var:tv_trade_score }
	}

	# Diplomatic = path 3  (score stored in tv_diplomatic_victory_points)
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_diplomatic_progress_pct
			var:tv_diplomatic_progress_pct >= var:tv_best_progress_pct
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_progress_pct  value = var:tv_diplomatic_progress_pct }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_path          value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_milestone      value = var:tv_diplomatic_milestone }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_score          value = var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
	}

	# Cultural = path 4  (score stored in tv_cultural_influence_points)
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_cultural_progress_pct
			var:tv_cultural_progress_pct >= var:tv_best_progress_pct
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_progress_pct  value = var:tv_cultural_progress_pct }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_path          value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_milestone      value = var:tv_cultural_milestone }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_score          value = var:tv_cultural_influence_points }
	}

	# Scientific = path 5
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_science_progress_pct
			var:tv_science_progress_pct >= var:tv_best_progress_pct
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_progress_pct  value = var:tv_science_progress_pct }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_path          value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_milestone      value = var:tv_science_milestone }
		set_variable = { name = tv_best_score          value = var:tv_science_score }
	}
}

# ── Situation-scope leaderboard rebuild ────────────────────────────────────────
# Iterates all countries, sorts descending by tv_best_progress_pct using five
# cascading ordered_in_global_list passes (pattern from rise_of_the_ottomans.txt).
# Each pass stores the winning country reference in tv_rank_N_country on this
# situation scope; the GUI reads path/milestone/score directly from that country.
tv_update_leaderboard_effect = {
	# Rebuild the sortable pool — only countries already initialised with progress data
	clear_global_variable_list = tv_country_pool
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_best_progress_pct }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = tv_country_pool  target = this }
	}

	# Rank 1 — highest tv_best_progress_pct
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = tv_country_pool
		order_by = { add = { value = var:tv_best_progress_pct } }
		limit = { has_variable = tv_best_progress_pct }
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		situation:tv_victory_situation = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_rank_1_country  value = prev }
		}
	}

	# Rank 2 — highest among the rest
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_rank_1_country }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = tv_country_pool
			order_by = { add = { value = var:tv_best_progress_pct } }
			limit = {
				has_variable = tv_best_progress_pct
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_1_country
			}
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			situation:tv_victory_situation = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_rank_2_country  value = prev }
			}
		}
	}

	# Rank 3
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_rank_2_country }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = tv_country_pool
			order_by = { add = { value = var:tv_best_progress_pct } }
			limit = {
				has_variable = tv_best_progress_pct
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_1_country
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_2_country
			}
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			situation:tv_victory_situation = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_rank_3_country  value = prev }
			}
		}
	}

	# Rank 4
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_rank_3_country }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = tv_country_pool
			order_by = { add = { value = var:tv_best_progress_pct } }
			limit = {
				has_variable = tv_best_progress_pct
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_1_country
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_2_country
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_3_country
			}
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			situation:tv_victory_situation = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_rank_4_country  value = prev }
			}
		}
	}

	# Rank 5
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_rank_4_country }
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = tv_country_pool
			order_by = { add = { value = var:tv_best_progress_pct } }
			limit = {
				has_variable = tv_best_progress_pct
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_1_country
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_2_country
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_3_country
				this != situation:tv_victory_situation.var:tv_rank_4_country
			}
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			situation:tv_victory_situation = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_rank_5_country  value = prev }
			}
		}
	}
}
